currency: USD per 1M tokens, Anthropic list price
notes: Model keys are matched by longest prefix, so a dated id such as
claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 resolves through its family key. A model that
matches nothing is counted in tokens but left unpriced — never priced at zero.
Cache rates are multipliers of `in` rather than absolute numbers, because
Anthropic quotes them that way; keeping them absolute here is how the two
drift apart on the next change.
Sonnet 5 carried an introductory rate of 2.00 / 10.00 through 2026-08-31.
List price is what is recorded here: this file is dated, and a promotion
is not. Copy the file and pass --prices to bill a promotion while it lasts.
